charter.title: Project Charter
charter.guideText: PMBOK: Develop Project Charter (Initiating process group). The charter formally authorizes the project and gives the project manager authority to apply resources.
charter.businessCaseHelp: Why is this project being undertaken?

stakeholders.title: Stakeholder Register
stakeholders.guideText: PMBOK: Identify Stakeholders & Plan Stakeholder Engagement. PRINCE2: Communication Management Strategy. The power-interest matrix helps derive an engagement strategy per stakeholder.

wbs.title: Work Breakdown Structure
wbs.guideText: PMBOK: Define Scope & Create WBS (Planning process group). The WBS decomposes project scope into manageable work packages — up to 4 levels here. Drag items to rearrange the hierarchy.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.guideText: PMBOK: Sequence Activities & Develop Schedule. Bars show each work package's start/end date; arrows represent finish-to-start dependencies.

risks.title: Risk Register
risks.guideText: PMBOK: Identify Risks, Perform Qualitative/Quantitative Risk Analysis (Planning process group). Risk score = probability × impact. PRINCE2: Risk Management Strategy.

budget.title: Budget Tracker
budget.guideText: PMBOK: Estimate Costs & Determine Budget (Planning process group). Compare planned vs. actual cost per work package to spot cost variance early.
budget.label: Label

taskboard.title: Task Board
taskboard.guideText: PMBOK: Direct and Manage Project Work (Executing process group). The Kanban board links tasks to the work packages from the WBS.

decisions.title: Meeting Notes & Decisions
decisions.guideText: PMBOK: Manage Communications (Executing process group). Capture meeting decisions and action items with owners and due dates.

statusReport.title: Status Report
statusReport.guideText: PMBOK: Monitor and Control Project Work (Monitoring & Controlling process group). One-click report with current RAG status, milestone progress, top risks, open issues, and budget burn.

raid.title: RAID Log
raid.guideText: PMBOK/PRINCE2: Unified view of Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (Monitoring & Controlling process group).

changeRequests.title: Change Requests
changeRequests.guideText: PMBOK: Perform Integrated Change Control (Monitoring & Controlling process group). Assess scope, time, and cost impact before approval.

lessonsLearned.title: Lessons Learned
lessonsLearned.guideText: PMBOK: Manage Project Knowledge (Closing process group). Capture insights per knowledge area for future projects.

closureChecklist.title: Project Closure Checklist
closureChecklist.guideText: PMBOK: Close Project or Phase (Closing process group). Confirm deliverables are accepted, documentation archived, resources released, and sponsor sign-off obtained.

businessCase.title: Business Case
businessCase.guideText: PRINCE2: Outline / Develop Business Case. Justifies why the project is worthwhile and is refined throughout the project.

stageGates.title: Stage Gates
stageGates.guideText: PRINCE2: Managing a Stage Boundary. Each stage ends with a review against a checklist before the next stage is authorized.

tolerances.title: Tolerances
tolerances.guideText: PRINCE2: Tolerances define the permitted deviation for each target before escalation is required.

backlog.title: Product Backlog
backlog.guideText: Scrum: Product Backlog Management. A prioritized list of desired features, estimated in story points.

sprintPlanning.title: Sprint Planning
sprintPlanning.guideText: Scrum: Sprint Planning. Create sprints with a timebox and goal, and assign backlog items to them.
sprintPlanning.noItems: No items in this sprint yet

sprintBoard.title: Sprint Board
sprintBoard.guideText: Scrum: Sprint Backlog / Daily Scrum. Track progress of the items committed to the sprint across Backlog, In Progress, Review, and Done.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in with your account credentials.
auth.registerSubtitle: Register for an account – an administrator needs to approve it afterwards.
auth.emailTaken: This email address is already registered.
auth.pendingSubtitle: Your account was created and is waiting for an administrator to approve it. If you were just granted access, try signing out and back in.
auth.disabledSubtitle: An administrator has disabled your account. Contact your administrator if you believe this is a mistake.

admin.title: User management
admin.subtitle: Approve users, assign roles, and manage accounts.
admin.cannotModifySelf: You cannot change your own role or status.

burndown.title: Burndown Chart
burndown.guideText: Scrum: Track sprint progress. Compares ideal vs. actual remaining work (story points) over the sprint.
burndown.noPoints: No story points in this sprint
